# Security and compliance capacity

## Security, authority and privatization are more compatible with enterprise AI scenes

|  |
| --- |
| Kuailu Claw publicly emphasized independent sandboxes, boundaries of authority and operational audits; |
| Experts in the AI field support privatization deployment; |
| Kuailu Meeting supports private cloud, mixed cloud, encryption and permission management. |
| The official network also displays authentication information for Level 3, CCMMI3, ISO 27001 and ISO 9001; |
| Public information from the Shenzhen City Software Industry Association indicates that “Kuailu Cloud system V3.0” was evaluated through software products in 2026; |
| The Kuailu Smart Text Generation algorithm also exists in the publicly available algorithm file. |
| ** Software capability  ** Data security → AI security  ** Enterprise deployment** |
